leads.title: Sexual Offences Act 1998 (as amended 2016), Sections 14 and 16
leads.documents: Legal status criminalizing same-sex activity pre-2024; defines gross indecency and buggery and penalties up to 12 years and 10 years, psychiatric hospital provision
leads.detail: Cited and quoted verbatim in article: Section 14(1)(2)(4) and Section 16(1)(2)(3); no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Dominica High Court ruling of 22 April 2024
leads.documents: Decriminalization ruling holding sodomy laws against consenting adults unconstitutional; read-down of Sections 14 and 16 to exempt private consensual adult acts
leads.detail: Date visible: 22 April 2024; April 2024 ruling that sections 14 and 16 unconstitutional; no URL visible

leads.title: High Court of Justice filing July 2019 challenging Sexual Offences Act
leads.documents: Rights machinery challenge to anal sex and gross indecency provisions; claimant account of homophobic hostility, harassment, threats, physical and sexual assaults, and police refusal to investigate home attack because gay people considered criminals
leads.detail: Filed July 2019 after announcement June 2019; challenged provisions punishable by up to 10 years and 12 years; no URL visible

leads.title: Prime Minister Roosevelt Skerrit statement 2014
leads.documents: Government enforcement policy stating law against homosexual activity not enforced in private homes with no plans to do so
leads.detail: Attributed to 2014; quote visible in Decriminalisation efforts section; no URL visible

leads.title: Catholic Bishop Gabriel Malzaire call for repeal 2013 / Holy See statement to 63rd session UN General Assembly
leads.documents: Institutional support for repeal; condemns violence and criminal penalties and states free sexual acts between adults must not be treated as crimes
leads.detail: Dated 2013; references Declaration of Human Rights, sexual orientation and gender identity; no URL visible

leads.title: Joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity - UN 2011
leads.documents: Official Dominican government support for LGBT rights at UN; Dominica signed as only UN member state in Lesser Antilles to do so
leads.detail: Signed by Dominican delegation in 2011; no URL visible

leads.title: Canadian HIV/AIDS Legal Network, University of Toronto International Human Rights Program, Minority Rights Dominica (MiRiDom), Lawyers Without Borders
leads.documents: Human-rights advocacy support for 2019 challenge; documents claimant's discrimination and violence and role of LGBTQ advocacy group MiRiDom founded by Darryl Philip
leads.detail: Named as supporters in June 2019 announcement; MiRiDom identified as LGBTQ advocacy group; no URL visible

leads.title: 2011 academic submission to the United Nations
leads.documents: Human-rights report that LGBTQ groups forced underground for fear of victimisation, openly gay members face vandalism, police reports not taken seriously and victims ridiculed
leads.detail: Dated 2011; cited in LGBT culture section; no URL visible

leads.title: 2010 Portsmouth killing of Clement James - suspected hate crime report
leads.documents: Documented incident of anti-LGBT violence; victim stabbed after being accused of watching assailant; accused Davis St Jean allegedly preached about killing gay people and said all battie boi must dead
leads.detail: Location Portsmouth, year 2010; victim Clement James, accused Davis St Jean; derogatory terms buggerman/battyman noted; no URL visible

leads.title: Evangelical Association statement by President Bill Daniel 2009
leads.documents: Social opposition to gay tourists and gay cruises; call for government to ensure gay tourists do not conduct themselves in immoral way and opposition to promoting Dominica as gay tourist destination
leads.detail: Dated 2009; quote visible in Opposition to gay tourists section; no URL visible
